name: BAT
definition: A Buyer Attribution Touchpoint (BAT) is a record created by Adobe Marketo Measure when an opportunity is created, copying Buyer Touchpoints from Contacts and associating them to the Opportunity, Account, and Contact objects, with a NET ARR value assigned.
page: Adobe Marketo Measure (formerly known as Bizible)
